text:
Dear Stanford team,
Thank you so much for everything! It was a real privilege to run a live deliberation on your platform, and the whole experience was genuinely inspiring. The care that's gone into the design really shows from the ground.
We learned a lot from this and came away excited about what deliberative democracy can do here in Japan. We'd love to stay in touch as both of our efforts grow.
Thank you again — looking forward to what's next!
Warmly,
 Hiito Sato
